specs.Picture Quality Enhancement Technology: Dolby Vision, VESA DisplayHDR 400, AMD FreeSync Premium, VESA AdaptiveSync

features: Performance Meets Ultrawide Immersion: Experience expansive vistas in WQHD ultrawide resolution, complemented by smooth, responsive gameplay.
HDR With Dolby Vision: Dolby Vision and VESA DisplayHDR 400 certification give games greater visual depth and excellent range from dark to light colours in every scene.
Immerse Yourself: Surround your eyes with the 34 inch 21:9 ultrawide screen, featuring a beautiful 1500R curve.
Fluid Performance: A 240 Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time combine with AMD FreeSync Premium and VESA AdaptiveSync for smooth, tear-free gaming.
Vibrant Worlds: With DCI-P3 95% colour coverage, Dolby Vision, and VESA DisplayHDR 400, virtual worlds come to life.
